environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) running as a systemd service under the 'webapp' user. The instance has wkhtmltopdf installed at /usr/local/bin/wkhtmltopdf. The container/host has no mandatory access control profiles applied. The Flask app is exposed directly on port 5000 via an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no L7 inspection. The 'webapp' user has standard shell access and /tmp is mounted with default options (exec permitted).
